title: Kafuli 🌿 Uttarakhand's green superfood curry #shorts

segments.moment_description: Carrying fresh green leaves into the courtyard

description:
Kafuli — the traditional green curry of the Himalayas 🌿🔥 A thick, creamy gravy of spinach and fenugreek leaves, slow-cooked on a wood stove the old Uttarakhand way.

Have you ever tried Pahadi (Himalayan) food? 👇 Tell me in the comments!

🌿 Made with spinach, fenugreek greens, green chilli, ginger, garlic and a little rice paste to thicken — pure comfort food from the mountains.

Did you know? Kafuli is the official state dish of Uttarakhand — an iron-rich green curry thickened with rice or wheat paste instead of cream, cooked in a traditional iron kadai.
